name: Artisan Sourdough Loaf
shortDescription: Crisp crust, tender crumb, and a 24-hour fermentation.
description:
Our signature sourdough loaf. The dough ferments for 24 hours with our house starter, without commercial yeast, then bakes at high heat for a thick crust and open crumb.

Keeps well for three to four days wrapped in a cloth. Toast briefly to refresh.
